package.name: rover_explore
package.description: Frontier exploration for the rover: the rover's own explorer node (path-distance frontier planning with reachability, viewpoints, commitment and a route through all frontiers; explore_lite stays available as a baseline), and an autosave node that saves map checkpoints and the final map, serializes the slam_toolbox pose graph, logs battery voltage and run metrics, and drives the rover back to its start pose when exploration completes.
